book.name: Korɛ̃ntitaamba sɛbɛhãalĩŋo
book.title: Polŋ nyɛgãaŋ sɛbɛhãalĩŋo maŋ hã Korɛ̃ntitaamba‑i

content: Terieŋgu faŋgu-na, iŋ ceŋ maacemma‑i baa Diiloŋo‑i, jande, i cãrã-nɛi, Diiloŋ uŋ ciɛ baa-na cemma maŋ, baa na bel-ku baa na nanyuɔŋgu.
Na saa da, Diiloŋo ciɛra wuɔ:

content.text: «Niŋ cãarã kumaŋ, ku huɔŋ da ku hi, mi ka ce-ku hã-ni.
Koŋkor-yiiŋ da ku hi, mi ka kor-ni.»

content: Mi tũnu-nɛi, koŋkor-yiiŋgu yaa daaku‑i. Diiloŋo taara u kor-na huɔŋ daaku yaa nuɔ‑i.
I sa taara i guɔl unaŋ gbeini a ce nuɔmba ji da muncãlmu i maacemma-na.
I yaaŋ aa tiɛ ce wɛima‑i hiere i pigãaŋ wuɔ Diiloŋ-cãarãaŋ miɛ kelkel. Mulĩɛma‑i baa sũlma‑i a naara korma sa ce-ye bĩŋkũŋgu, i caa-ni hũmmaŋ-temma.
Ba muyaa-ye babalaa, aa dii-ye kaso‑i-na, aa tũu nuɔmba‑i kũnna-yiɛ. Kuniɛ maacemma maaramma ce i sa da duɔfũŋ, i sa bi da wuo niiwuoni.
I pigãaŋ wuɔ Diiloŋ-cãarãaŋ miɛ i viisĩnni-na, baa i Diiloŋ-hũmelle suɔma-na, baa i hɔhĩnaŋga-na, baa i fafaaŋgu-na, baa *Diiloŋ-Yalle maacemma-na, baa i nelnyufafammu-na,
baa i ninsoŋo wamma-na, baa Diiloŋ-fɔ̃ŋgũɔ bi barguɔ‑i-na. I ciɛ viisĩnni yaa‑i i bɛrcebĩmbĩnni‑i tiɛ muo baa-ni aa tiɛ cenya i fɛrɛ baa-ni.
Yiiŋgu naŋgu ba ce i ce bɔi, yiiŋgu naŋgu ba ture i yammu‑i. Ba waŋ i yebabalande‑i dii, ba waŋ i yefafalle‑i dii. Ba ne-ye wuɔ coikartaaŋ miɛ, a ne da i waŋ ninsoŋo yaa‑i.
Ba ne-ye ŋaa ba sa suɔ-ye, a ne da ba suɔ-ye fafamma. Ba ne-ye wuɔ bikuoŋ miɛ, a ne da miɛmɛi daaye i gbeini-na. Ba huol i yammu‑i ŋga ba saa gbãa ko-ye.

Ba ce kuujaŋgu yiɛ, i hɔmmu bir yaŋ aa ta mu fɛ̃. Ba ne-ye wuɔ nawalaaŋ miɛ, a ne da miɛmɛi ciɛŋ nuɔmba bɔi waamba. Ba ne-ye wuɔ bĩŋkũŋgu sĩ baa-ye, ba saa suɔ wuɔ miɛmɛi bĩŋkũntaaŋ miɛŋo‑i kelkel.
Mi jɛ̃naaŋ namaa, Korɛ̃ntitaaŋ namaa, i fũnuŋ firnu i hɔmmu‑i a piiye baa-na.
I saa fuo i kusũnni‑i nɛi, ŋga namɛi fuyaa na kusũnni‑i miɛ-na.
A ce dumaaŋo-na mi ka piiye baa-na ŋaa mi piiye baa mi bisãlmba: Firiinuŋ na bi hɔmmu‑i baa-ye fafamma!
Cecerma‑i baa kukulma‑i ni siɛ gbãa gbonu
Bamaŋ saa hũu Kirsa-maama‑i, baa na dii na nuŋgu baa-ba ba ãncemma-na. Kuufafaaŋgu‑i baa kuubabalaaŋgu gbãa ce niɛ kã hũmeduɔle? Cecerma gbãa nunu ma-naa baa kukulma‑i nunuŋ hama‑i temma‑i?
*Kirsa‑i baa *Sitãni‑i, ba gbãa suurnu ba-naa niɛ niɛ? Sisɔ umaŋ Kirsa horre-na, u gbãa gbonu ce hama‑i baa umaŋ si dii-diɛ?
Diiloŋ-dũŋgu‑i baa tĩnni‑i ni piyaa ni-naa bige‑i nuɔ‑i? Miɛmɛi Cicɛ̃lmantieŋo dũŋgu‑i ŋaa fuɔ fɛrɛŋ waaŋ-ma dumaa wuɔ:

content.text: «Mi ka tĩɛna ce mi bãaŋgu‑i baa-ba.
Mi ka waa ba Diiloŋ muɔ

content: Terieŋgu faŋgu-na, Itieŋo nel daama vii namɛi wuɔ:

content.text: Baŋ bĩŋ kumaŋ bĩŋkũbabalaaŋgu‑i, baa na yiɛya-kuɔ,
ku yaa mi ka yaŋ na piɛ-mi.
Mi ka waa na To muɔ
aa na waa mi bɛpuɔŋ namaa baa mi bieŋ namaa.»

content: Itieŋo‑i Wɛimantieŋo ãndaaŋgu yaa‑i.
